settings.heading: Manage deliveries
settings.body: Skip a shipment, change your next order date, or update your delivery frequency.

settings.heading: Manage your account
settings.body: Update subscription products, payment details, or delivery address in our secure portal.

settings.heading: Cancel or pause
settings.body: You can pause or cancel your subscription using the provider's cancellation option.

settings.question: How do I access my subscription?
settings.answer: Use the secure link sent to your email after subscribing, or open the portal using the button above once your store has configured it.

settings.question: Can I cancel?
settings.answer: Yes. Your subscription app provides a cancellation flow and confirmation. Contact support if you need assistance.
